greeting: Halt. The sacred forge must not be disturbed.
You may not pass... yet. State your purpose.
I am Guardian Magmamoto. This forge is under my protection.
The flames within are ancient. Respect them.
You return. Have you found center?
Approach with reverence. The forge judges all.
I have guarded this place for twenty years. It has changed me.
Many seek the forge's power. Few are worthy.
dialog.challenge: Beyond lies the Sacred Forge. Only the balanced may enter. Are you balanced?
dialog.warning: The forge shows you truth. Many cannot bear truth.
dialog.recognition_high_rep: Ah. You carry the weight of good deeds. The forge welcomes such weight.
dialog.advice: In the forge's heat, impurities burn away. This is true for metal. Also for souls.
dialog.let_pass: You may enter. Remember: the forge reflects what you bring to it.
dialog.personal_philosophy: Strength is not force. Strength is endurance. I endure. Therefore I am strong.
rumor: The forge was built before the Collapse. Its fires are older than memory.
Prism has crystal chambers. Similar purpose. Different element.
Frost has the opposite. Cold so deep it burns. Balance in all things.
Tide's depths hold pressure. Another kind of forge.
dialog.combat_bark: You mistake my stillness for weakness! HI-YAH!
farewell: Go in balance. Return in balance.
The forge remembers those who enter.
Return when you are ready for truth.
dialog.time_dawn: Dawn brings new seekers. I am ready.
dialog.time_noon: The sun peaks. The forge burns brightest. Good time for judgment.
dialog.time_night: Night is deepest stillness. The forge glows. I watch.

party_reactions.kade: I will definitely not be wrestling you. Ever.
party_reactions.nix7: Center of gravity: optimal. Stance: perfect. Threat assessment: high.
party_reactions.twist: WHOA! You're BIG! Can we PUSH each other?!
party_reactions.korr: True discipline shows in stillness. You are disciplined.
party_reactions.renna: Do you meditate? Your aura suggests deep contemplation.
party_reactions.suresh: Guardianship is sacred duty. You honor your post.
party_reactions.sova: I wouldn't want to fight you. I'd lose. Quickly.
party_reactions.grit: Seen your type in elite units. Unmovable. Unstoppable.
party_reactions.ashka: Fire runs through you. Not just around you.
party_reactions.senna: Still water runs deep. Or still magma, in this case.
party_reactions.callum: You look very... solid. Is that comfortable?

relationship_dialog.acquaintance: I recognize you. You return with questions.
relationship_dialog.friend: Friend. The forge welcomes you. As do I.
relationship_dialog.best_friend: Old friend. You bring balance to this place. Enter freely.
